[d0474] config | partitioner.batch_size | version 4.x
# `partitioner.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `256` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | messages |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `partitioner.batch_size` only if you observe problems with the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
batch_size = 256
```

---

# `scheduler.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `500` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | messages |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `scheduler.batch_size` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
batch_size = 500
```
